instruction: I went on lunch with my coworkers yesterday at Enchanted Eats. My manager paid for food and everyone venmoed them. Everyones' transactions except mine should be on my social feed. My share was $20. How much did my manager pay for the others, including me, yesterday?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes, only knowledge gathering. supervisor.show_profile yields the phone number (phone username) and email (venmo username); show_account_passwords yields passwords. Both phone.search_contacts calls (coworker and manager, each paginated) are modeled by one action parameterized by query/relationship; the relationship values are domain constants so venmo-show-social-feed can require both lookups plus the current date before it asserts (found-total ?amt). The total answer is 20 plus the amounts of the qualifying coworker->manager 'Enchanted Eats' transactions from yesterday in the social feed; it is passed as the answer parameter of supervisor-complete-task, which must be last.
